# Shenmue I conversation entry appendix

Reviewed 2026-10-21. Generated alongside the [master event list](shenmue1-story-event-master.generated.md); do not edit this output.

**4173 source entry markers across 257 unique actor resources.** The original archive contains 4327 physical entries; repeated identical actor resources are counted once. These are conversation branches, not 4173 additional unique story events. Named plot conversations in the master list can occur here too.

This appendix makes the ordinary-dialogue family inspectable without treating every subtitle or camera cut as an event. Each row is an original actor-resource entry selected by the existing native decoder. A representative question or reply helps find a topic; it is not a reconstructed transcript, execution order or a claim that alternate branches all play together.

Source: [compact native index](../../tools/evidence/shenmue1-story-event-sources.generated.json); [existing selector/body decoder](../../tools/scripting/extract_dialogue_actor_body_routes.py); archive SHA-256 `c61b53f0784442505e491a2bba7dc8f608495922f69acfb253be8c10492570a7`. HUMANS copies on discs 1, 2, 3 were verified byte-identical. The index retains each resource hash, original archive copies, entry/body offsets, numeric predicate identities, all decoded message indices and decoder boundaries. Character message links supply text and voice IDs.

**Limits:** 61 entries have no statically recovered spoken lines; 0 have no matching localized message catalog; 2841 encounter dynamic, nested or progress-redirection boundaries. Those rows remain visible. A lifecycle return alone does not prove original eligibility or runtime support. Exact story/date predicates, semantic deduplication, unreachable content and presentation readiness still require review.
